content:
Hi Michael

How is your account connecting to your provider's server, using Imap or older pop3 protocol? The pop3 protocol doesn't support folders.

Imap folders are displayed in the account side menu. Press the top left ≡ menu button to display this. If you see Unified account listed, press the down arrow and select an account.

If some of the imap special folders are missing, navigate to ...

  • Settings > account name > folders
  • Check each special folder has it's imap folder name assigned.
  • Sent folder = Automatic (Sent Mail) as example.

Hi Michael

Your screenshot shows the Unified inbox.

Unified inbox is displayed when you have multiple email accounts added to the app. It's purpose is to show the inbox content from multiple accounts within a single combined view.

Per my last reply: "If you see Unified account listed, press the down arrow and select an account."

All your account folders will then be displayed within the sidebar, instead of Unified Inbox.
